# Suhas Beemineni

Portfolio: https://suhaslord.github.io/portfolio/
GitHub: https://github.com/suhaslord

Student building aerospace simulations and reliable AI systems.

- AegisLand: independent, simulation-only research on landing-camera reliability. Phase 10R failed the preregistered all-gates rule. Do not describe it as a pass or physical-aircraft validation.
  https://suhaslord.github.io/portfolio/work/aegisland.html
- Voyager / Elodin: trajectory-error telemetry (PR #769) and heliocentric relative dynamics (PR #789) merged. Jupiter validation PR #805 is open as of September 5, 2026; check GitHub for current status. Contributions to a simulation example, not flight software.
  https://suhaslord.github.io/portfolio/work/voyager.html
- AbstainBench: a 30-question browser prototype. Its label-aware offline baseline checks the pipeline and is not a model-performance result.
  https://suhaslord.github.io/portfolio/work/abstainbench.html

The homepage flyby is an illustrative two-body model, not measured Voyager telemetry. Case-study pages link to primary evidence.
